//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> World Border -> Config

Enable World Border.//: Whether World Border is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

enableCustomOverworldBorder.//: When enabled, uses the overworldBorderCoords to set the border.

enableCustomNetherBorder.//: When enabled, uses the netherBorderCoords to set the border.

enableCustomEndBorder.//: When enabled, uses the endBorderCoords to set the border.

shouldLoopToOppositeBorder.//: When enabled, instead of teleporting the player inside near where they were, teleports them from the positive to the negative x/z coord and vice versa.

distanceTeleportedBack.//: The amount of blocks the player is teleported inside after hitting the border. min: 0, max: 1,000

nearBorderMessage.//: The message which will be sent to the player when they are within 'distanceTeleportedBack' to the world border.
nearBorderMessage.value: You're getting close to the world border!

hitBorderMessage.//: The message which will be sent to the player when they hit the world border.
hitBorderMessage.value: You've hit the world border, and were teleported inside!

loopBorderMessage.//: The message sent to the player when they hit the border and 'shouldLoopToOppositeBorder' is enabled.
loopBorderMessage.value: You've hit the world border, and have looped around the world!

overworldBorderPositiveX.//: The overworld border located at the positive x coordinate. min: 0, max: 100,000

overworldBorderNegativeX.//: The overworld border located at the negative x coordinate. min: -100,000, max: 0

overworldBorderPositiveZ.//: The overworld border located at the positive z coordinate. min: 0, max: 100,000

overworldBorderNegativeZ.//: The overworld border located at the negative z coordinate. min: -100,000, max: 0

netherBorderPositiveX.//: The nether border located at the positive x coordinate. min: 0, max: 100,000

netherBorderNegativeX.//: The nether border located at the negative x coordinate. min: -100,000, max: 0

netherBorderPositiveZ.//: The nether border located at the positive z coordinate. min: 0, max: 100,000

netherBorderNegativeZ.//: The nether border located at the negative z coordinate. min: -100,000, max: 0

endBorderPositiveX.//: The end border located at the positive x coordinate. min: 0, max: 100,000

endBorderNegativeX.//: The end border located at the negative x coordinate. min: -100,000, max: 0

endBorderPositiveZ.//: The end border located at the positive z coordinate. min: 0, max: 100,000

endBorderNegativeZ.//: The end border located at the negative z coordinate. min: -100,000, max: 0
